title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 — Urban Green Space and Housing Pressure
prompt: In many cities, land that could be used for new housing is also valued as public green space, and local governments must decide how to allocate it. Some people argue that building homes should take priority because housing shortages cause serious social and economic problems, while others believe that parks and green areas are essential to residents' health and to the long-term quality of city life. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion on how city authorities should balance housing needs against the protection of green space. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类 Task 2 议论文练习。请先分别说明两种观点（优先建住房 / 优先保护绿地）各自的理由，再明确给出你自己的立场，并说明市政部门应如何平衡二者。所有情境与数据均为模拟，非官方雅思试卷。建议用 40 分钟，写满至少 250 词，结构清晰，论点有例证支撑。
